BAR_BOUNDARY.CONTROL_WINDOW_FIRST_PRICE_TIMESTAMP_RUL: open_price at WINDOW_START, where WINDOW_START = WINDOW_END - 24h and WINDOW_END = T - 1 minute. Equals the close of the 1m bar that closes at WINDOW_START.
BAR_BOUNDARY.CONTROL_WINDOW_LAST_PRICE_TIMESTAMP_RULE: open_price at WINDOW_END = T - 1 minute. Equals the close of the 1m bar that closes at WINDOW_END. The bar that opens at T-1 minute is not included from its open to its close.
BAR_BOUNDARY.EVENT_WINDOW_FIRST_PRICE_TIMESTAMP_RULE: open_price at WINDOW_START, where WINDOW_START = WINDOW_END - 24h and WINDOW_END = T - 1 minute. Equals the close of the 1m bar that closes at WINDOW_START.
BAR_BOUNDARY.EVENT_WINDOW_LAST_PRICE_TIMESTAMP_RULE: open_price at WINDOW_END = T - 1 minute. Equals the close of the 1m bar that closes at WINDOW_END. The bar that opens at T-1 minute is not included from its open to its close.

F2_POWER: F2 five-year sign stability remains required for PROMISING_PROTOTYPE and is not part of the 0.80 power claim.
GROUP_DEFINITION: Intersection of the original YEAR x WEEKDAY x UTC_HOUR permutations and the automorphism group of the frozen 198-node overlap graph.

PLANNING_SCALE_ILLUSTRATIONS.NOTE: PLANNING-SCALE ILLUSTRATIONS. Not empirical BTC MDEs. Percent = MDE_SINGLE_WINDOW_SD_UNITS times the assumed SD, times 100.

P_VALUE_RULE: (1 + count(|T_perm| >= |T_obs|)) / (1 + draws). Ties use >=. p cannot be 0.
RESIDUAL_EXCHANGEABILITY_ASSUMPTION: Window returns that share a stratum and the same overlap-graph role (isolate, or matched endpoint of an equivalent cross-stratum edge) are exchangeable under the null. Preserving the overlap graph does not prove that BTC returns are unconditionally exchangeable.
STANDARDIZED_UNIT: One single-window SD unit is the standard deviation of one window return under scenario A (independent unit-variance window noise). delta is the mean shift added to every originally labeled event window, in those units. A matched-difference SD under scenario A is sqrt(2), the SD of an independent event-minus-control pair. Stress scenario C multiplies every window variance by 2 and does not rescale delta.
STATISTIC: mean(event 24h log return) - mean(matched-control 24h log return)
STRUCTURAL_INVARIANCE_STATEMENT: Conditional on the same within-stratum exchangeability assumption already required by the original C012 design, the amended randomization group no longer contains transformations that alter the frozen overlap-dependence topology.
UNIFORM_SAMPLING_JUSTIFICATION: G_C012_TOPO is the direct product of symmetric groups on isolate classes and symmetric groups on cross-stratum matching edges. A uniform group element pushes forward to the uniform distribution on the label orbit because every orbit point has the same stabilizer order. Independent uniform draws on those factors implement that pushforward. Cross-stratum edges are not flipped, because a flip would change stratum.
